column2: Elemental Weakness , Temporal Chains , Profane Ritual , Vulnerability
* Fixed a bug where Burning Inscription Support would create ignited ground around a monster instead of on top of the Runic Inscription.
- Fixed a bug where Curses and ground effects from supports such as Burning Inscription could sometimes fail to be placed on the ground if cast too close to a wall or in a narrow area.
- Burning Inscription now has a 110% Cost Multiplier (previously 100%). - Fixed an issue where some Triggered Skills were able to generate Energy, such as Burning Inscription.
